reviewed_by: Codex scoped review of simulation rollback snapshot retention
reason: The ten selected Python cases exercise retention of the current coherent snapshot, deletion of older recognized snapshots without following links, refusal of unfamiliar paths before deletion, a visible cleanup failure or receipt-write failure that preserves a healthy Core, recovery from a partially completed cleanup, retry with no new candidate, preservation of unreviewed rollback state, cleanup order after accepted health, and failed-promotion rollback without pruning. The copied deployment gate is unchanged; it is included to make the installed deployer source complete.
exclusions: This change affects simulation deployment automation and repository instructions, not Nebula UI, API, native code, or browser behavior. No frontend, native, or Playwright tests apply. A disposable LAN Core cannot exercise the host's systemd deployment boundary, so isolated filesystem and service-order tests cover the changed behavior. Full suites are excluded.
